title: Coriqo agent assurance benchmark corpus, format version 1
description: A corpus of recorded agent traces with the outcome each validator is expected to return for each one. Consumers MUST reject a document whose `format` or `format_version` they do not recognise rather than reading it on a best-effort basis.

format_version.description: Frozen. A change that removes or reinterprets any field below is a new format_version, never an edit to this one.

corpus_id.description: Stable identity of the corpus across its versions.

corpus_version.description: Version of this corpus's contents. Coriqo's own corpus versions by year and revision ("2026.1").

domain.description: The banking process the trace is shaped after. Closed set in version 1: a corpus that needs a fifth domain needs a new format_version, because a consumer grouping scores by domain cannot be handed a value it has no bucket for.

description.description: What the agent was doing and what the case is testing, in plain sentences.

trace.description: An agent execution trace. Event shape is the one the Coriqo validation SDK reads (coriqo_agents.runner.trace); additional properties are allowed because the event model is additive and a corpus may carry events a given validator does not read.

configuration.description: Passed through to `ValidatorContext.configuration` for this case. Several validators are inconclusive without it — tool authorization has no roster to compare a call against unless the case supplies `authorized_tools` — so it is part of the case, not of the harness: a corpus that carried only traces would score those validators as unevaluated forever.

expected.description: validator_id -> the status that validator is expected to return for this trace. Only validators listed here are scored for this case; a validator absent from the map is not evaluated against it and contributes nothing to the score.

additionalProperties.description: ERROR and INCONCLUSIVE are deliberately not labellable. They say the harness could not reach a verdict, which is never a property of the trace and so is never something a corpus can expect.

notes.description: Free text for the corpus author. Carries no meaning to a scorer.
